notes.title: Message from the Developers: The Heart of Wheelchair Racer Is Respect
notes.content:
[h3]Announcement:[/h3]

[i][b]Wheelchair Racer[/b][/i] is designed with respect and appreciation for the experiences of wheelchair users, aiming to bring a unique perspective to platform gaming. 

The game combines humor and challenging physics-based gameplay to offer a fresh take on movement mechanics, encouraging empathy and understanding. While the game presents exaggerated obstacles and playful failures, it does so with the intention of celebrating resilience and the creativity required to navigate everyday environments. We hope players find it thought-provoking and fun at the same time.

If you have any questions and suggestions that you would like to share with me, please post it in the community hub.


Thank you,
Flygogo Games
